SELECT
    abc_class,
    count() AS product_count
FROM
(
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        multiIf(cumulative_revenue_share <= 0.80, 'A', cumulative_revenue_share <= 0.95, 'B', 'C') AS abc_class
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            product_revenue,
            sum(product_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY product_revenue DESC, ProductKey ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / total_revenue AS cumulative_revenue_share
        FROM
        (
            SELECT
                ProductKey,
                sum(SalesAmount) AS product_revenue,
                sum(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER () AS total_revenue
            FROM retail.FactSales
            WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
            GROUP BY ProductKey
        )
    )
)
GROUP BY abc_class
ORDER BY abc_class;
